# 🔄 FORZA HORIZON 6 — UPDATE GUIDE

**Latest version: v440.853** (Steam Build 25104224)

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 🧭 Pick Your Path
- **On Anker v430.771?** → tap **📥 Anker Update** — a quick **2.2 GB** update-only.
- **On an older FitGirl install?** → the new repack (**v440.853 + 23 DLCs + Multiplayer**) already has every update and DLC baked in. Download it from **Step 1** of the main guide and install over a fresh folder.
- **After any update** → reapply the **Online Fix** (Step 3 of the main guide, or **🎮 Multiplayer** for the Anker version) — updates overwrite it.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## ⚙️ If RUNE Updates Fail

Go back to your **original FitGirl download** and install the **Extra Languages** and **HD Videos** optional components — RUNE updates sometimes require these files to be present. Once installed, try the update again.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 📢 Stay Up To Date

This guide may fall behind the latest releases. For the most current info:
- **FitGirl comments:** https://fitgirl-repacks.site/forza-horizon-6/
- **CS.RIN.RU thread:** https://cs.rin.ru/forum/viewtopic.php?f=41&t=151803&hilit=forza+horizon+6
